Topics · Is there a God?

Can words about God ever be true to Him?

No picture or word holds the One, the Quran agrees. Yet names are doors, and He is nearer than the vein.

Part 1 of 4

﴿فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ أَزْوَٰجًا ۖ يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ ۚ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

[He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him,[1411] and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.[1412]

Translator's notes

[1411] There is no similarity whatsoever between the Creator and His creation in essence, in attributes or in deed. [1412] See footnotes to 17:1.

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:11

Translation

To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him? “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.

Original · Hebrew

וְאֶל־מִ֖י תְּדַמְּי֣וּן אֵ֑ל וּמַה־דְּמ֖וּת תַּ֥עַרְכוּ לֽוֹ׃ וְאֶל־מִ֥י תְדַמְּי֖וּנִי וְאֶשְׁוֶ֑ה יֹאמַ֖ר קָדֽוֹשׁ׃

Isaiah · 40:18, 25

World English Bible

Begin where your tradition begins: what is greatest cannot be netted in words. This passage begins there too. It says that nothing is like Him. No picture, shape or comparison will hold Him. Taken seriously, every sentence about Him is a signpost and never the town. The text accepts that caution before it says one thing more.

A question for you

When someone speaks with great confidence about the ultimate, what do you feel?

If you sayRespect, if they sound humble.
ThenHumility is how this passage begins: a limit on comparison before any speech.
If you saySuspicion.
ThenThat suspicion serves the truth. The passage itself warns against any description that believes it has surrounded its subject.
If you sayCuriosity.
ThenThe next passage makes the limit clearer, and then opens a door.

Part 2 of 4

﴿لَّا تُدْرِكُهُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Vision perceives Him not,[332] but He perceives [all] vision; and He is the Subtle,[333] the Aware.[334]

Translator's notes

[332] In the life of this world. The people of Paradise will be able to see Allāh in the Hereafter. See 75:22-23. [333] Perceptive of the most precise and unapparent matters and the intricacies of all affairs. Also, He who benefits His servants in indiscernible ways. [334] See footnote in 6:18.

Quran · Al-An'am 6:103

Translation

which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

Original · Ancient Greek

ἣν καιροῖς ἰδίοις δείξει ὁ μακάριος καὶ μόνος δυνάστης, ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν βασιλευόντων καὶ κύριος τῶν κυριευόντων, ὁ μόνος ἔχων ἀθανασίαν, φῶς οἰκῶν ἀπρόσιτον, ὃν εἶδεν οὐδεὶς ἀνθρώπων οὐδὲ ἰδεῖν δύναται· ᾧ τιμὴ καὶ κράτος αἰώνιον· ἀμήν.

1 Timothy · 6:15-16

World English Bible

﴿يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلْمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

He [i.e., Allāh] knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them,[857] but they do not encompass it [i.e., what He knows] in knowledge.

Translator's notes

[857] Allāh’s knowledge encompasses every aspect of His creations in the past, present and future.

Quran · Ta-Ha 20:110

The Quran says the limit twice. Sight does not grasp Him, though He grasps every sight. Knowledge does not encompass Him, though He knows what is before and behind them. So the limit is not an accident of language. It belongs to what is being spoken of. Care with words before what lies beyond them is not a modern worry.

A question for you

Which limit is closer to your sense of things: that we cannot see Him, or that we cannot fully know Him?

If you sayThat we cannot see Him.
ThenThat limit is in the first passage, along with the thought that He takes in everything we see.
If you sayThat we cannot fully know Him.
ThenThat limit is in the second passage, along with the thought that He knows what lies before us and behind us.
If you sayBoth.
ThenThen you stand where the Quran stands, which says both together.

Part 3 of 4

﴿قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ ۖ أَيًّا مَّا تَدْعُوا۟ فَلَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَٱبْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "Call upon Allāh or call upon the Most Merciful [ar-Raḥmān]. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.

Quran · Al-Isra 17:110

Translation

Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples. Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works. Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.

Original · Hebrew

הוֹד֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה קִרְא֣וּ בִּשְׁמ֑וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִילוֹתָֽיו׃ שִֽׁירוּ־ל֭וֹ זַמְּרוּ־ל֑וֹ שִׂ֝֗יחוּ בְּכָל־נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃ הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב ׀ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהוָֽה׃

the Psalms · 105:1-3

World English Bible

If words fail, why does the Quran speak at all? This passage gives names and says: call on Him by any of them, whichever you call. The names are not a cage. They are doors a person may turn toward. Each says something true without holding the One it points to: Merciful, Near, Hearing. The speech is for the one who speaks. It helps the heart turn.

A question for you

If a name does anything, what does it do?

If you sayIt points me in a direction.
ThenThat is close to what the verse says: names are doors one turns toward.
If you sayIt helps me be quiet.
ThenThe same verse speaks of a middle way between loud and hushed in calling, so quiet has its place.
If you sayNothing real.
ThenThat possibility stands. The question left is what the names point to, even if they do not hold it.

Part 4 of 4

﴿وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer[1528] to him than [his] jugular vein.

Translator's notes

[1528] In absolute knowledge of everything about him. "We" has also been interpreted to mean the angels who are mentioned in the following verse.

Quran · Qaf 50:16

Translation

You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.

Original · Hebrew

קָר֣וֹב אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה וְֽכָל־מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אֱמֶֽת׃

the Psalms · 119:151

World English Bible

The same book says one more thing beside the limit: the One who cannot be grasped is nearer than the vein in your neck. So the limit of words is not distance. It is more like the limit of seeing your own eye. Speech about Him may stay small and still be a way home. Silence and speech do not compete here. Both are ways of turning.

A question for you

Which comes first for you: silence or words?

If you saySilence.
ThenThe verse puts nearness exactly there, where no explaining is needed.
If you sayWords.
ThenWords are a door too, if we remember they are signs and not enclosure.
If you sayThey take turns.
ThenThat is close to the life of someone who calls: speech, then quiet, then speech.

The same in the other books

Translation

Remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me. I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will stand, and I will do all that I please.

Isaiah · 46:9-10

World English Bible

Translation

For this time I will send all my plagues against your heart, against your officials, and against your people; that you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.

כִּ֣י ׀ בַּפַּ֣עַם הַזֹּ֗את אֲנִ֨י שֹׁלֵ֜חַ אֶת־כָּל־מַגֵּפֹתַי֙ אֶֽל־לִבְּךָ֔ וּבַעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ וּבְעַמֶּ֑ךָ בַּעֲב֣וּר תֵּדַ֔ע כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין כָּמֹ֖נִי בְּכָל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
